algorithm: raw-AST typed boxed-continuation CPS with bounded dependent request groups, dependency-first ordered match, projection values, bounded nonrecursive storage islands, bounded private-helper result deforestation, bounded private-region helper/continuation inlining and quantity-checked alias scalarization, and structurally recursive native heterogeneous-stack chunks
nativeTerminationClaim: Generated source handlers and continuation helpers form an acyclic declaration graph. Result-deforested producer and continuation helpers are private, acyclic and emitted before their users; each forwards the same affine fields and captures once. Single-use private helpers are additionally spliced into their sole call site only after alpha-freshening every retained binder and checking every parameter quantity, which removes a call but introduces no new declaration, recursion or effect. Only the native chunk scheduler is self-recursive, structurally decreasing an operational Nat on every RunState transition. Zero returns the remaining Run unchanged; RunFinished returns directly. Native push/pop transfers affine progress, resume and stack once, never reassociates Bound and never allocates composition closures. This does not alter canonical semantic fuel or claim termination of the complete host-driven computation.

boxedTransport.unboxing: One generic named parameter-match getter consumes the carrier; a single Let restores each authenticated source result quantity: Many for Data, Lone for affine Type; existing continuation helpers retain named parameter matches; no computed/local native matches or unsafe casts

nativeChunk.finishedTransport: native stack pop passes whole box to source resume; StackDone consumes checked equality through Value<_> and returns RunFinished
nativeChunk.stackOwnership: Affine heterogeneous native LIFO; no host stack, no Bound reassociation, no Compose nodes, no per-site constructors

loweringSourcePolicy: Binding-aware AST composition of every declaration in the explicit canonical provider closure, under the owned native-provider header; exact canonical source/declaration hashes and composed hashes are separate, with complete symbol ownership. Typed CPS factors matches once.
administrativeQuantityPolicy: Live-use-directed Many promotion only for authenticated Data; canonical request quantities and erased binders unchanged

directInvocation.policy: Typed source closure only when target precedes owner in authenticated source order; erased request witness preserves exact result type; affine boxed resume uses one generic parameter-match getter and one quantity-preserving Let; live arguments transferred once into the affine closure; all public request handlers retained; future/self/backedge calls remain pending
directInvocation.arguments: Authentic Base False{}; unused scalar affine callback token; five-field Direct with boxed resume

tailCallFusion.policy: Identity Finished{Value{value}} continuation only; target precedes owner in authenticated source order; projection-only arguments with a live variable; typed target Progress and all request handlers retained; cycles and closed computations remain pending

resultDeforestation.policy: Compiler-private pure producer helpers returning one single-constructor record (Pair/ArenaResult/ArenaStore/...), immediately destructured by their single-use generated match consumer, are composed along the acyclic pure helper DAG: every tail record construction becomes one call to a shared continuation helper with the same fields and captures. Source request handlers, effectful step bodies, traced boundaries, semantic fuel and quantum 64 are untouched; captures are variables or erased terms, retained binders are alpha-freshened, fields are consumed once, and unfusable shapes (dependent fields, recursive or effectful producers, multiple consumers) are left as ordinary CPS.

privateRegionScalarization.policy: A generated private helper referenced exactly once is a non-escaping continuation. Its sole call is replaced by its body when splicing is grammar-safe: a match-free body at a body tail (locals follow locals), a single-expression body at any value position, and a root match only at a definition body (never a row or local tail) with exactly one Match node, live non-erased caller-parameter scrutinees in strictly increasing telescope order, and no computed scrutinee. Parameters are substituted only by variables or literals, every retained Body/term binder is alpha-freshened through one scope-aware environment, and a variable parameter used more than once along one sequential path (mutually exclusive match rows use the per-binder maximum, exactly like administrative grading) is accepted only when the caller binder is Many or is one call-site parameter this pass relaxes to Many under the same authenticated-Data kind test; locals are never relabelled and an erased argument may not consume a Lone binder. Sites record how many caller parameters they promoted. Independently, private `name = value` aliases are scalarized away when the value is a variable or literal and the quantity/use-count rules prove no duplication (a Lone alias forwards at most one use to a value that still has at most one use; a literal or alias is never forwarded into a match scrutinee, which must keep its relative pending-binder order). Private source handlers, pure source bodies, traced boundaries, request dispatch, evaluation order, semantic fuel and quantum 64 are untouched; refused shapes stay exactly as generated.

pureCallClassification.policy: Live source argument required. Projections do not construct values or call functions. Checker arena wrappers and core_bound_unaffected may compose admitted helpers with native Arena/U32/Nat and IR.arena_* scalar range/bit calls and bounded constructors, in dependency order; this admits the nonrecursive arena view/accessor closure but no recursion, indirect calls or function binders. All other definitions retain CPS
